author: rdc-rfc1-author-a (Claude Haiku 5.5)
rationale: rst_q is a one-stage reset synchroniser that directly releases the asynchronous clear of q, so a metastable release can reach the pipeline.

author_reading.rationale: rst_q is a single flop releasing the asynchronous clear of q with no second stage, so a metastable release can reach the functional state.

labels.rationale: rst_q is a single flop with D=1 and async reset rst_n. It releases q directly with no second stage, so the release can be metastable and unsafe. This is a shallow chain, which RDC-006 covers.
A single flop samples asynchronous release and directly controls the pipeline reset. A metastable sample can reach every pipeline bit without a second stage.

settlement.rationale: Both readers agree on verdict, class, critical and RDC-006, and differ only in site lines. The settler merges them as rst_q at line 11 and the receiver procedure at line 15.
